terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the École Étoile filante directory. By creating an account, you accept them. Please also read our privacy policy, which explains how we protect your personal information.
terms.serviceBody:
The directory is a free service provided by the Comité Bottin, a committee of volunteer parents at École Étoile filante. It helps families and school staff reach each other, organize committees and help one another.
The directory is not a service of the school or of the Centre de services scolaire de Montréal.
terms.accessBody:
The directory is reserved for parents and guardians of students at the school and for school staff. Only email addresses authorized by the committee can create an account.
Your account is personal. You must keep your password confidential and notify us promptly if you believe someone else has used your account.
terms.acceptableUseBody:
Directory information may only be used for school community purposes. You may not:
• use it for commercial, political or religious solicitation
• send mass mailings unrelated to the school
• copy, export, publish or share directory information with anyone who does not have access to it
• harass, intimidate or bother anyone
• attempt to access information or features you are not entitled to
terms.accuracyBody: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for keeping it up to date. You confirm that you hold parental authority over the children you register. If you provide information about another person, such as another parent's address, you confirm that they have agreed to it.
terms.availabilityBody: The directory is run by volunteers. We do our best to keep it available and accurate, but we cannot guarantee that it will work without interruption or error.
terms.suspensionBody:
The committee may suspend or close an account that does not comply with these terms, or when the person is no longer part of the school community.
You may leave the directory at any time using the opt-out button on the update form, or by writing to us.
terms.liabilityBody: To the extent permitted by law, the Comité Bottin and its volunteers are not liable for damages arising from the use of the directory, a service interruption, or misuse of information by another user. Nothing in these terms limits the rights the law guarantees you.
terms.changesBody: We may change these terms. If we make a significant change, we will notify you by email or in the directory before it takes effect.
terms.lawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of Québec and the applicable laws of Canada. The French version prevails over any translation.
terms.contactBody: For any question about these terms: bottin.etoile.filante@gmail.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The Comité Bottin respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information the École Étoile filante directory collects, why we collect it, who has access to it and how to exercise your rights. It applies to the directory and to the annual update form.
privacy.whoBody: The directory is an initiative of the Comité Bottin, a committee of volunteer parents at École Étoile filante. The committee is responsible for the personal information collected by the directory. The school and the Centre de services scolaire de Montréal do not manage it.
privacy.officerTitle: Person in charge of the protection of personal information
privacy.officerBody:
The person who chairs the Comité Bottin is in charge of the protection of personal information. They ensure this policy is followed, answer your requests and complaints, and handle any confidentiality incident.
To reach them: bottin.etoile.filante@gmail.com
privacy.collectedBody:
Parents and guardians:
• name, email and phone number
• address
• interests and committee memberships

Students: name, class and level, and their link to their parents.

School staff: name, title, email and phone number.

Account: email and password. Passwords are managed by Google Firebase; the committee never has access to them.

Feedback sent to the committee.

Technical logs: see the "Cookies and technical logs" section.
privacy.purposesBody:
We use this information only to:
• help families and school staff reach each other
• organize committees and volunteering
• send the annual update email and directory-related communications
• keep the directory secure and improve it

We never sell, rent or trade your information. It is never used for commercial or political purposes.
privacy.consentBody:
You give your consent by filling out the update form. You provide your children's information as a holder of parental authority. If you indicate that another parent lives at the same address, you confirm that they have agreed to it.
You may withdraw your consent at any time using the opt-out button on the update form, or by writing to us. Your information is then removed from the directory; only your name and email are kept for essential school communications.
privacy.accessBody:
Only people with a verified account, that is parents and school staff, can view the directory. Committee volunteers who administer the directory have access to all information, solely to manage it.
We do not share any information with anyone else, unless required by law.
privacy.providersBody:
We use the following services to run the directory:
• Google Firebase: hosting, accounts, database and processing. Data is stored in Montréal.
• Gmail (Google): sending directory emails.

Some of these providers may process information outside Québec. Before entrusting them with information, we assessed that it receives adequate protection.
privacy.retentionBody:
We keep your information as long as you have a child at the school. When a student leaves the school or completes grade 6, their information is deleted. A parent's information is deleted when they no longer have a child at the school.
The log of administrative actions is kept for at most two years.
privacy.securityBody: We protect your information with reasonable measures: access limited to accounts with a verified email, database access rules, encrypted communications, and administrative access limited to the volunteers who need it.
privacy.rightsBody:
You may:
• access the information we hold about you
• have it corrected
• withdraw your consent and ask for it to be deleted
• get a copy of it in a structured, commonly used technological format

You can correct most of your information yourself with the update form. For any other request, write to bottin.etoile.filante@gmail.com. We will reply within 30 days.
If you are not satisfied with our answer, you may file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.
privacy.incidentsBody: We record every confidentiality incident. If an incident presents a risk of serious injury, we promptly notify the Commission d'accès à l'information and the people concerned.
privacy.cookiesBody:
The directory stores your language choice and your sign-in session in your browser. It does not use any analytics or advertising tools.
Our servers keep technical logs (date, errors and IP address) to diagnose problems. They are deleted automatically after 30 days.
privacy.changesBody: We may change this policy. If we make a significant change, we will notify you by email or in the directory. The effective date appears at the top of the page.
